info.title: 211 Ontario - Resources Search API (clone)
info.description:
Search 211 Ontario resources using a range of parameters to filter the response.

## Two-call pattern
`/search` returns an 18-field summary record and does **not** include contact details. Phone, website, hours, languages offered, accessibility, fees and application process are available only from `GET /serviceatlocation/{id}`, keyed on the `serviceAtLocationId` returned by search. Plan for one detail call per record you intend to display in full.

## Request and response names differ
Field names you **send** (searchFields, selectFields, filters, facets) are index names such as `nameOrganization` and `descriptionService`. Field names you **receive** are different: `organizationName`, `serviceDescription`. Results are wrapped in `item`, not `document`. Both sets are documented below; do not assume one applies to the other.

## Silent failures to be aware of
Unrecognised `filters[].field` values and unrecognised body properties are discarded without error, returning HTTP 200 and unfiltered results. The geocoding flag on POST is spelled `useGecodeService`; the correctly spelled variant is ignored. See the SearchInputDto property descriptions.

## CORS
No CORS headers are returned, so browser clients cannot call this API directly. Call it from a server-side proxy.

Verified against the deployed clone API on 13 Aug 2026.

get.description:
Returns the full service-at-location record, including contact details, hours, languages offered and accessibility information.

The path is `/serviceatlocation/{id}` - no hyphens, and the id is a path segment. Earlier revisions of this document described `/service-at-location?id=...`, which does not exist and returns 404 for every id.

Use the `serviceAtLocationId` from a search result as the id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Service-at-location id, as returned in `results[].item.serviceAtLocationId` by /search.

example.serviceAtLocationName: Bloor West Food Bank at Toronto
example.serviceDescription: Food bank, serving inside - line up on Cosburn Ave.
example.applicationProcess: New clients need to register online.
example.documentsRequired: Government issued identification for each member of the household.
example.disabilitiesAccess: Wheelchair accessible - come to Cosburn doors

404.description: Not Found - no record with that id.

get.description:
Searches the index of 211 Ontario service-at-location records.

`location` is REQUIRED on this operation; omitting it returns HTTP 400 with `{"errors":{"location":["The location field is required."]}}`. Use the POST operation for filters, facets, field selection, or to search without a location.

The total number of matching records is returned as `count` at the top of the response.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: One or more words to search for. To match all entered words, set searchMode to 'all'.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: REQUIRED. City, county, postal code or province. Set distance to restrict results to a radius; set searchWithinLocation to true to return resources inside the location's boundary.

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: Number of kilometres from the entered location. Not applicable when searchWithinLocation is true.

parameters.name: searchWithinLocation
parameters.description: Search within the geographic boundary of the location.

parameters.name: searchMode
parameters.description: 'any' to match one or more keywords, 'all' to match all.

parameters.name: useGeocodeService
parameters.description: Geocode the location for distance or boundary searches. Defaults to true on this operation. Note the POST operation reads a differently spelled property (useGecodeService) and defaults it to false.

item.serviceAtLocationName: Bloor West Food Bank at Toronto
Bloor West Food Bank at Toronto

400.description: Bad Request - most commonly a missing 'location'.

post.description:
Searches the index of 211 Ontario service-at-location records, with filters, facets and field selection. `location` is optional here.

Geocoding is OFF unless `useGecodeService` is true, and without it `location` and `distance` have no effect - the full index is returned with HTTP 200. Note the spelling of that property carefully.

The total number of matching records is returned as `count` when includeTotalCount is true.

item.serviceAtLocationName: Bloor West Food Bank at Toronto
Bloor West Food Bank at Toronto

400.description: Bad Request - e.g. an invalid selectFields or searchFields entry.

Address.description: Address as returned by the API. Note the field names differ from earlier versions of this document: address1/address2 (not streetAddress), plus 'type'. Latitude and longitude are NOT inside this object - they are top-level properties of the search result item.

HoursStandard.description: Structured opening hours. Populated for roughly a third of sampled records; fall back to the corresponding *HoursText field when this array is empty.

number.description: May include an extension inline, e.g. '416-479-0015 ext 202'.

SearchFilter.description: Identifies a field to filter and the value to filter it on. See the SearchInputDto 'filters' description for valid field names and for the silent-failure warning.

field.description: Field to filter on. Taxonomy filters use the bare leaf name (taxonomyTermLevel1, taxonomyTermLevel2, taxonomyTerm); address and service-area filters use the path form (address/city, address/stateProvince, serviceAreas/value).

value.description: Value to filter on. Match is exact and case-sensitive, e.g. 'Basic Needs'.

search.description: One or more keywords. Use '*' to match all records. Set searchMode to 'any' to match at least one word, 'all' to match every word.

location.description: City, county, postal code or province. Optional on POST (unlike GET, where it is required). Has NO effect unless useGecodeService is also set to true - see that field.

distance.description: Radius in kilometres from the geocoded location. Requires useGecodeService: true. Ignored when searchWithinLocation is true.

searchWithinLocation.description: Return resources within the geographic boundary of 'location' rather than within a radius. Requires useGecodeService: true.

useGecodeService.description:
Enables the geocoding service, which is what makes 'location', 'distance' and 'searchWithinLocation' take effect.

WARNING - the property name is misspelled (it is missing the 'o' in 'Geocode'), and this misspelling is the name the API actually reads. The correctly spelled 'useGeocodeService' is silently ignored on POST, which causes location and distance to be dropped and returns the entire province with HTTP 200 and no error. The GET operation uses the correctly spelled 'useGeocodeService' and defaults it to true. Take care when porting a query between the two verbs.

skip.description: Number of results to skip, for paging.

includeTotalCount.description: Include the total number of matching records as 'count' at the top of the response.

filters.description:
Each entry is {field, value} and multiple entries are combined with AND.

IMPORTANT - field naming is not uniform:
  * Taxonomy filters use the BARE leaf name, with no 'taxonomy/' prefix: taxonomyTermLevel1, taxonomyTermLevel2, taxonomyTerm.
  * Address and service-area filters use the PATH form: address/city, address/stateProvince, serviceAreas/value.
Using 'taxonomy/taxonomyTermLevel1' in a filter does NOT work - see the warning below.

Fields confirmed to filter: taxonomyTermLevel1, taxonomyTermLevel2, taxonomyTerm, address/city, address/stateProvince, serviceAreas/value.

Fields accepted but IGNORED (no error, no effect): taxonomyTermLevel3 through taxonomyTermLevel6, taxonomyCode, status, and any path-form taxonomy field.

WARNING: unrecognised filter fields are silently discarded and the request returns HTTP 200 with the FULL unfiltered result set. A mistyped or unsupported filter therefore looks like a working filter that matched everything. Always sanity-check the returned count against an unfiltered baseline. To narrow by a taxonomy node deeper than level 2, filter on taxonomyTerm instead.

facets.description: Facets to return alongside results, for building filter UIs. Facets use the PATH form, e.g. 'taxonomy/taxonomyTermLevel1', 'taxonomy/taxonomyTermLevel2', 'address/stateProvince', 'serviceAreas/value'. Append ',count:N' to raise the number of facet values returned (the default is 10), e.g. 'taxonomy/taxonomyTermLevel1,count:50'. Note that a value valid as a facet is not necessarily valid as a filter - compare the filters description.

searchFields.description: Fields searched by the keyword query. Valid values (these are INDEX field names and differ from the names in the response - see SearchResultItem): idServiceAtLocation, idOrganization, idService, idLocation, nameOrganization, nameService, nameLocation, nameServiceAtLocation, alternateNamesOrganization, alternateNamesService, descriptionOrganization, descriptionService, address, taxonomy, serviceAreas, status. Sub-paths are also accepted: address/streetAddress, address/city, address/county, address/stateProvince, address/postalCode, address/country, address/latitude, address/longitude, taxonomy/taxonomyTerm, taxonomy/taxonomyCode, taxonomy/taxonomyTermLevel1 through taxonomy/taxonomyTermLevel6, taxonomy/linkedTerm, serviceAreas/type, serviceAreas/value. Invalid names cause HTTP 400. 'latitude', 'longitude' and 'score' are NOT valid here even though they appear in responses.

selectFields.description: Fields to populate in search results. Unrequested properties are returned as null rather than omitted, so the response shape is unchanged. Valid values (these are INDEX field names and differ from the names in the response - see SearchResultItem): idServiceAtLocation, idOrganization, idService, idLocation, nameOrganization, nameService, nameLocation, nameServiceAtLocation, alternateNamesOrganization, alternateNamesService, descriptionOrganization, descriptionService, address, taxonomy, serviceAreas, status. Sub-paths are also accepted: address/streetAddress, address/city, address/county, address/stateProvince, address/postalCode, address/country, address/latitude, address/longitude, taxonomy/taxonomyTerm, taxonomy/taxonomyCode, taxonomy/taxonomyTermLevel1 through taxonomy/taxonomyTermLevel6, taxonomy/linkedTerm, serviceAreas/type, serviceAreas/value. Invalid names cause HTTP 400. 'latitude', 'longitude' and 'score' are NOT valid here even though they appear in responses.

searchMode.description: 'any' to match one or more search words, 'all' to match all.

count.description: Total matching records, when includeTotalCount is true.

facets.description: Keyed by the requested facet expression, e.g. 'taxonomy/taxonomyTermLevel1'.

SearchResult.description: A single search hit. The record is under 'item' - earlier revisions of this document called it 'document'.

SearchResultItem.description: A service-at-location record as returned in search results. This object contains exactly 18 properties and does NOT include contact information (phone, email, website, hours, languages, accessibility). Those fields are not present in the search index at all - retrieve them per record from GET /serviceatlocation/{id}.

status.description: Observed as null in all sampled records. Not filterable.

ServiceAtLocationDetail.description: Full service-at-location record (31 properties). This is the only place contact details, hours, languages and accessibility information are exposed.

serviceHoursText.description: Free-text hours. More widely populated than serviceHoursStandard; use as the display fallback.

locationHoursStandard.description: Not observed populated in sampled records.

languagesOffered.description: Language names, e.g. 'English', 'French', 'Arabic'. Available per record on this endpoint only - it is not in the search index and therefore cannot be used as a search filter or facet.

locationPhones.description: Not observed populated in sampled records.

locationContacts.description: Not observed populated in sampled records.

Taxonomy.description: Taxonomy entry as returned by the API. Output names are code/term/levelNName. The corresponding INPUT names used by filters, facets, searchFields and selectFields are different - see SearchInputDto.
